citation: Vats, Madho Sarup. 1940. Excavations at Harappa: Being an Account of Archaeological Excavations at Harappa Carried Out between the Years 1920–21 and 1933–34. 2 vols. (Vol. I Text; Vol. II 139 plates). Delhi: Manager of Publications. By the Deputy Director-General of Archaeology in India.
notes: Primary ASI report for early Harappa excavations (1920–21 to 1933–34). Antiquity review (Childe) and eHRAF/Archive metadata confirm two-volume format. Planned as complement to Marshall 1931 and Mackay’s Further Excavations. Historical P-tier: absolute dates outdated; use for Cemetery H, mounds, and early Harappa find documentation. Digitized IGNCA copy on Internet Archive (accessed 2026-10-11).
